invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of an execute() operation which is expected to produce a HoodieWriteMetadata.
The input list of keys is passed to another method and used in constructor, so it should be non-null.
The instantTime is used in the construction of a commit action; it should be present and non-null.
The write statistics inside HoodieWriteMetadata should be initialized after deletion commit execution.
The write status is a main output of the underlying JavaDeleteCommitActionExecutor and should not be null.
